eventId.description: a UUID v7 that is the parent id of the event when used to track multiple stages of an event

systemId.description: the system generating the event. The hashtag (#) can be used to separate process and function names. The order should be system#sub1#sub2

eventType.description: the event type. Event type can be used to filter

eventId1.description: a UUIDv7 that can be used to group events with a sub process

eventId2.description: a UUIDv7 that can be used to further group events with a sub process under an eventId1

sequenceNumber.description: a sequence number used to order events within the same process or thread

timestamp.description: a timestamp used to order events within the same process or thread

info.description: optional information attributes as key, value pairs
